ANSWER: YES

HALLUCINATIONS:
- States that merger restrictions were “modified to permit ‘merge with or into any other Person.’” The amendment only replaces the wording of a negative covenant in Section 8.2(a); it does not permit mergers.

ANSWER: YES

MISSING_TERMS:
- Waiver of any interest or fees that may have accrued at the post-Default rate solely in connection with the Potential Specified Defaults (Section 3.1(b)).

{"has_issues": true, "issues": ["Claims the amendment provides a higher Change of Control threshold of 25% while simultaneously stating the prior threshold is undisclosed; you cannot assert it is higher without knowing the prior level.", "States merger restrictions were modified to permit the company to \"merge with or into any other Person,\" yet also asserts relief is only for signing and that the merger closing will be a prohibited Change of Control event that triggers termination\u2014permitted vs. prohibited treatment of the merger is inconsistent."]}
